name: B10-0211/2026 (Renew) – Ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Russia's leaders and allies to be held responsible for the war against Ukraine and for attacks on civilians, hospitals, schools and energy supplies. It wants a new court for the crime of aggression to start work soon, and a claims body so victims can get compensation. It also asks for sanctions to stay and grow, and for the EU to keep funding the bodies that gather evidence and prosecute.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is asking the EU to join the new court and claims body and keep funding prosecutors.
- **Who it affects:** Russia's leadership and allies, Ukrainian victims, and EU governments and companies.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide on joining and funding; the court and claims body must still be set up.
